cases.prompt: Use sw-spec for a new accepted feature with two actors, a decision branch and a state change, and no illustration.
assertions: The illustration chip is needs illustration
sw-spec invokes sw-spec visuals before the review gate
sw-spec writes the returned diagram link
shared lint runs after the illustration link is applied

cases.prompt: Use sw-spec to resume a feature whose illustration still matches its depicted actors, branches, labels and source IDs.
assertions: The illustration chip is illustrated
sw-spec visuals is not invoked
The existing illustration is left unchanged
The recorded no-op names the current paths and source IDs

cases.prompt: Use sw-spec to amend a feature after a recorded CR changes a branch shown in its illustration.
assertions: The illustration chip is check illustration
sw-spec invokes sw-spec visuals because the depicted branch changed
sw-spec updates the draft link after the illustration is redrawn
shared lint runs again after the link change

cases.prompt: Use sw-spec for a new accepted feature with one actor and a linear flow, and no illustration.
assertions: The illustration chip is no illustration
sw-spec visuals is not invoked
The story keeps a paragraph in place of a diagram

cases.prompt: Use sw-spec for a feature the author dismisses with illustration_check.py --dismiss and a reason.
assertions: The illustration chip is no illustration
The dismissal is recorded in front matter with a reason
The draft hash is unchanged by the dismissal

cases.prompt: Use sw-spec to specify all reserved features of the accepted refund split.
assertions: One worker is used per reserved feature
Each worker writes only its own 02-drafts/FEAT-NNN files
The lead saves questions, trace, graph and data once after the guard passes
The parallel_guard verify result is clean before the lead writes shared state
No station is advanced without the user's confirmation

cases.prompt: Use sw-spec to write the story for the reserved feature FEAT-001
assertions: Runs new_story.py --reserved and keeps the reserved ID, title and aliases
Fills all twelve sections in template order
At least two criteria have concrete inputs and observable outputs
The draft hash is stamped and the card is generated

cases.prompt: Use sw-spec to amend a published story without a change request
assertions: Stops: no CR and no current Jira snapshot
Writes nothing
Never writes to Jira

cases.prompt: Use sw-spec to generate the card for a story whose summary runs past 150 words
assertions: card_gen.py exits 1 and writes no card
The summary is shortened by editing the story, not by raising the limit

cases.prompt: Use sw-spec to withdraw AC-001-2 after a recorded CR
assertions: The withdrawn criterion stays as a struck-through tombstone that names the CR
No later criterion reuses the number
The draft hash is restamped
